error[ZBX-E0209]: can't set up the read-only rootfs
  cause  the rootfs has no such directory and is not writable by this user, so
         it cannot be made; a read-only rootfs needs /tmp and /run before it is
         made read-only
  fix    make them as the rootfs's owner:   mkdir -p "/srv/alpine/tmp" "/srv/alpine/run"
         or unpack the rootfs as the user who runs zbx
  more   zbx explain E0209 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0209.html
